We’re Opening Our Google Cloud Infrastructure to Researchers, Healthcare Teams & Builders
Most people don’t struggle with writing code.
They struggle with cloud setup, billing, IAM, scaling, and operational overhead. At David Labs, we’ve been running production workloads on Google Cloud Platform for our own products (AI, healthcare, data platforms). We’re now opening that same infrastructure to others who want to explore, research, or build on GCP without managing everything themselves. AI research fellows experimenting with Google’s AI models
Healthcare teams exploring analytics, HL7 pipelines, or secure data processing
Developers & founders validating SaaS ideas
Teams learning GCP hands-on without billing anxiety
What we provide
GitHub Enterprise
Org, repos, CI/CD pipelines Google Cloud Platform
Cloud Run, IAM, OAuth
Any GCP service (including AI & data services) MongoDB Atlas
Premium M10 cluster Stripe
Billing integration (if you plan to monetize) Hubble
Our in-house data visualization tool
https://hubble.davidlabs.ca Subdomain hosting (yourapp.davidlabs.ca) You focus on code, research, or product logic.
We handle infra, scaling, security, and cloud plumbing. Revenue share: 70% you / 30% us (Stripe auto-split)
Monthly rent: usage-based + 15% infra management fee
Research / AI workloads: custom, project-based setup
✔ No equity
